snippet.title: Dev Peek 01 - Bringing the Frog to Life
snippet.description:
In this short log, we'll outline the process we went through in order to bring our very own frog character to life.

Everything you see is being made by the Black Flamingo Games team for the game we're creating.

If you're interested in the project, come visit our Discord server and wish-list the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3892380/Frog_Pond_Simulator
